units: Gen. R. s. 91 (ref. to Gen. XLII, 1) אל תהי קורא יש שבר אלא יש ס׳ … שסִבְרוֹ וכ׳ read not yesh sheber (there is corn) but yesh seber (there is hope) &c., v. אִסְפַּקְלַרְיָא. Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII ושמא תאמר אבד סִבְרִי ואבד סכויי … אני סִבְרְךָ וכ׳ lest thou say, my hope is gone, my outlook is frustrated, therefore it reads, ‘I am the Lord’, I am thy hope &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 72a:12">Yoma 72ᵃ</cite> <he>אבד סִבְרָן ובטל סכויין</he> their prospect of restoration is gone &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21b:2">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אבד סִבְרָם וכ׳</he> they are beyond hope (of return to God) &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 33b:5">B. Mets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>פסק סברם ובטל סכוים</he> there is no hope for them &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 371">Yalk. Is. 371</cite> … <he>שכרן … שיכויין</he> (read <he>שִׂבְרָן</he>).

senses.gloss: with פָּנִים, brightness, friendly expression; in gen. countenance.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:15">Ab. I, 15</cite> <he>הוי מקבל … בס׳ פ׳ יפות</he> receive every man with a countenance of friendliness.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 158:1">Yalk. Sam. 158</cite> <he>כך הוא סִבְרוֹ של דבר</he> this is the plain sense of the thing (the common opinion), opp. to <he>עיקרו של דבר</he> the root, the deeper cause; v. <cite ref="O00091"><he>סְבָרָא</he></cite>.
